svg.title: Leadership and more: AI-in-Energy Hackathon: Led it: 450+ participants, £25k in prizes, sponsors incl. Google, Anthropic and Beckn.; Google Developer Groups: Lead at Imperial, after a year as Technical Director of the student club.; DhanDanaDan: Founded a financial literacy platform that certified 5,500+ learners. UN V-Award 2022.; WatchBOT: Founded a computer vision startup for classroom attention. US$20k raised, piloted in 3 schools.; AP Scholar with Distinction: 5/5 in Calculus BC, Statistics and Physics C. Merit, Indian Olympiad Qualifier in Maths.; Off the keyboard: Guitar, RSL Grade 8 Merit. Tennis for Imperial and for Haryana in AITA tournaments.
